prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

This PR adds the `fixCleanup3_6_0` amendment, intended to be a catchall amendment for most small bugs that need an amendment gate that are included in 3.6. If there are none, this can be removed at that time.

## Context of Change

Adding a separate PR just to add the amendment makes it easier to manage separate/independent PRs that may require the amendment.

## API Impact
